errors.evidence: The x-axis represents 要素距离 (distance categories), not modes.
The legend label in the figure is “本文方法”, not “本技法”.
The two series are shown with white/light and gray hatch fills; the baseline model is not black.

errors.text_span: “远”模式的柱状图的长度约为 56%。
errors.evidence: At the '远' category, one bar is around 59% and the other is around 56%; the machine description assigns 56% to the category generically and omits the higher bar.
The description does not correctly mention that each category has two bars and that the two methods are distinguished by different hatch fills/gray levels.
